description: Northern Ireland Railways NIR Culverts is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by OpenDataNI. A northern Ireland Railways Structure asset with a span or diameter greater than 450mm and less than 1800mm whose primary purpose is usually, but not exclusively, to permit water or services to pass under or adjacent to the railway, road or other NIR Infrastructure. This term excludes Third Party Pipelines. Coverage: OpenDataNI. The portal files it under the publisher OpenDataNI. Its tags are Bridges, Culvert, Designated Access Points, Government, INSPIRE. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON. The portal shows 2023-04-06 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
